class.name: chrono_supervisory_fmu_hw_interface/ChronoSupervisoryFmuSystemInterface
class.description: 분산 버전 (distributed version): runs on the supervisory-controller machine alongside ros2_control, owns the same velocity->torque control logic as chrono_ros2_control/ChronoFmuSystemInterface, but talks to chrono_split_dynamics_node on a separate machine over ONE bridge (chrono_split_msgs VehicleCommand/VehicleStatus) instead of calling fmu_client locally.
